reason: I want to choose my own vegetables, fruit and meat, and I don't trust anyone else to pick them. A stranger shopping my list is exactly what I avoid.
objection: Someone else picks my tomatoes and my meat, and I can't check them before I pay. If it's bad I've already paid the till price plus the fee, in cash.
would_change_my_mind: If I could send them only for dry goods, cartons and bulk items, and still pick my own fresh produce and meat, I might try it for those.
